frequency_rule_has_limit.name: frequency_rule_has_limit
frequency_rule_has_limit.value: "frequency_rule"."min_gap_days" IS NOT NULL OR "frequency_rule"."max_per_week" IS NOT NULL

frequency_rule_limits_positive.name: frequency_rule_limits_positive
frequency_rule_limits_positive.value: ("frequency_rule"."min_gap_days" IS NULL OR "frequency_rule"."min_gap_days" >= 1) AND ("frequency_rule"."max_per_week" IS NULL OR "frequency_rule"."max_per_week" >= 0)

planning_weights_range.name: planning_weights_range
planning_weights_range.value: "planning_weights"."macro_precision" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "planning_weights"."appeal" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "planning_weights"."ingredient_economy" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "planning_weights"."variety" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "planning_weights"."fairness" BETWEEN 0 AND 1
